title: Osier Holt
shortDescription: Withies cut for baskets, and a path to the race.
longDescription:
Withies stand in bundles, cut for Collegium baskets and not yet stolen. The river is louder south of here, where the mill-race drops.
West is the willow bend. South is the mill-race. East, past the cut stools, somebody has trodden a path that does not go to the water.

fixtures.name: Withy Bundles
fixtures.lookDescription: Bundles of cut withy. Examine them.
fixtures.examineDescription: The withies are tied with Collegium twine, the green sort Tansy uses. One bundle is missing its twine. Marram says the camp likes baskets because baskets do not look stolen until you know the knot.
